probable_root_cause: Three consecutive invalid password attempts for user test-user-01 from client IP 198.51.100.23 exhausted the lockout threshold of 3, so auth-service rejected the login (reason: invalid_credentials) and locked the account for 15 minutes. All attempts came from a single user and a single IP, which is consistent with a forgotten password rather than a distributed brute-force attack.
troubleshooting_steps: Confirm with user test-user-01 whether they made the attempts from 198.51.100.23 (a single user and single IP suggests forgotten credentials).
Verify the account unlocks after the 15-minute lockout (lockout_minutes: 15).
Watch for repeated failures from 198.51.100.23 after the unlock, which would indicate a brute-force attempt.
Offer a password reset for test-user-01 if the failures continue.
expected_resolution: The account unlocks after the 15-minute lockout, test-user-01 authenticates successfully with the correct password or a reset, and no further invalid-password warnings are logged for 198.51.100.23.
